objects.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
objects.description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands.
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor executed commands and arguments for suspicious activity.

objects.name: PowerShell
objects.description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.
objects.x_mitre_detection: Enable PowerShell script block logging and module logging.

objects.name: Phishing
objects.description: Adversaries may send phishing messages to gain access to victim systems.
objects.x_mitre_detection: Inspect email headers and malicious links.

objects.name: Spearphishing Attachment
objects.description: Adversaries may send spearphishing emails with a malicious file attachment.
objects.x_mitre_detection: Scan attachments using antivirus and detonation sandbox.

objects.name: Valid Accounts
objects.description: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts.
objects.x_mitre_detection: Audit account logins and unusual geographical access patterns.

objects.name: OS Credential Dumping
objects.description: Adversaries may attempt to dump credentials from the operating system.
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor accesses to LSASS and SAM registry hives.

objects.name: LSASS Memory
objects.description: Adversaries may attempt to access LSASS memory to extract password hashes.
objects.x_mitre_detection: Enable LSA protection and monitor process access to lsass.exe.

objects.name: Process Injection
objects.description: Adversaries may inject code into processes in order to evade process-based defenses.
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor API calls commonly used for process injection.

objects.name: Dynamic-link Library Injection
objects.description: Adversaries may inject DLLs into processes in order to evade defenses.
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor DLL load events and unexpected image loads.

objects.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
objects.description: Adversaries may encrypt data on target systems to interrupt availability.
objects.x_mitre_detection: Monitor file modification and rename events for mass encryption patterns.
